newsitem.title: UK: BFI gains a further 18 points.
newsitem.headline: BFI gains a further 18 points.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index rose 18 points on Thursday to 1,256 but several brokers claimed that the market was entering a quieter phase and that the frantic activity of the past 10-14 days was over.

A number of Panamaxes in the Atlantic failed on subjects but brokers believed the underlying tone remained firm and that Chinese charterers were still active with fertiliser fixtures in particular, from the Continent and U.S.Gulf to China.
Caper rates continued to appreciate in the Pacific but were relatively static in the West.
BIFFEX was hit by profittaking and dipped by between 20 and 40 points with turnover at 1200 GMT totalling 225 lots.
